2609.03635.title: Analysis of Prompt Engineering for Drug Toxicity Prediction
2609.03635.paper_summary: Clinical trials in the UK can cost up to £1.3 million, with approximately 90% drug failure rate. Toxicity is a major contributing factor in drug failure. Testing is time and cost intensive. In recent years, the use of artificial intelligence has been increasingly explored to aid in the prediction of drug toxicity, with extensive use of large language models (LLMs). However, LLMs can show considerable variation when minor changes are made to prompts, which raises concerns about their sensitivity to prompt engineering. Prompt engineering is used to optimise a prompt given to an LLM to generate the desired output. This paper proposes a method to analyse prompt engineering for drug toxicity prediction. The aim of the paper is to investigate the importance of prompt phrasing for drug toxicity prediction. LLMs were prompted to identify chemical properties of significance when predicting drug toxicity. Prompts were constructed to investigate; job role, prompt structuring, and rule interpretation. LLMs were then used to generate datasets, using the identified features from initial prompting, which were then passed to machine learning algorithms. The experiments show that the natural variance which occurs in LLMs outweighs any fine-tuning of prompts. There were, however, substantial improvements in model performance when using chemoinformatic code to extract features instead of using LLM-generated values. The proposed analysis methodology is applicable to a wide range of prompt types across different areas of bioinformatics.
2609.03635.paper_summary_zh: 臨床試驗在英國的成本可達130萬英鎊，藥物失敗率約為90%。毒性是藥物失敗的主要因素。測試耗時且成本高昂。近年來，人工智慧的使用越來越受到關注，以協助預測藥物毒性，並廣泛使用大型語言模型（LLMs）。然而，當對提示進行微小更改時，LLMs可能會顯示出相當大的變異，這引發了對其對提示工程敏感性的擔憂。提示工程用於優化給LLM的提示，以生成所需的輸出。本文提出了一種分析藥物毒性預測的提示工程的方法。本文的目的是調查提示措辭對藥物毒性預測的重要性。LLMs被提示識別在預測藥物毒性時的重要化學特性。提示被構建以調查；職位角色、提示結構和規則解釋。然後使用LLMs生成數據集，使用從初始提示中識別的特徵，這些數據集隨後被傳遞給機器學習算法。實驗顯示，LLMs中自然變異的影響超過了任何提示的微調。然而，當使用化學信息學代碼提取特徵而不是使用LLM生成的值時，模型性能有了顯著改善。所提出的分析方法適用於不同生物信息學領域的各種提示類型。
